name: @velella/ebb-mcp
title: Ebb Lifecycle & Deprecation MCP Server
description: Official Model Context Protocol server for Ebb: verify package end-of-life dates, deprecations, and replacement targets.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Check a package URL (PURL) or software product at a specific version against known end-of-life and deprecation dates.

purl.description: Package URL (e.g. 'pkg:npm/request@2.88.2', 'pkg:npm/request', 'pkg:pypi/django@1.11') or bare product name (e.g. 'node', 'django').

version.description: Version string to check (e.g. '2.88.2'). If omitted, version embedded in the PURL is used.

asOf.description: Optional reference date in YYYY-MM-DD format to compute daysLeft relative to.

tools.name: check_all
tools.description: Check multiple package URLs (PURLs) or dependencies in batch against known end-of-life and deprecation dates.

purls.description: List of package URLs (e.g. 'pkg:npm/request@2.88.2') or objects to check in batch.

tools.name: replacement_for
tools.description: Get the recommended replacement package or migration target for a deprecated or end-of-life component version.

purl.description: Package URL (e.g. 'pkg:npm/request@2.88.2', 'pkg:npm/request') or bare product name (e.g. 'node', 'django').

version.description: Version string (e.g. '2.88.2'). If omitted, version embedded in the PURL is used.

resources.name: Upcoming software end-of-life and deprecations
resources.description: Scheduled software deprecation and end-of-life dates that have not yet occurred.
